title: Mad Science
description: This transforming event card can be any type (Attack, Skill, or Power) based on TinkerTimeType. [gold]Base effects:[/gold] As an Attack, deal 12 damage. As a Skill, gain 8 [gold]Block[/gold]. If a TinkerTime Rider is attached, additional effects apply: [gold]Sapping[/gold]: Apply 2 [gold]Weak[/gold] and 2 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]. [gold]Choking[/gold]: Whenever you play a card this turn, the enemy loses 6 HP. [gold]Energized[/gold]: Gain 2 [gold]Energy[/gold]. [gold]Wisdom[/gold]: Draw 3 cards. [gold]Chaos[/gold]: Add a random card to your hand; it's free to play this turn. [gold]Expertise[/gold]: Gain 2 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 2 [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. [gold]Curious[/gold]: Powers cost 1 [gold]Energy[/gold] less. [gold]Improvement[/gold]: At the end of combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a random card.
notes: Mad Science is a transformer card that is created with a random CardType (Attack, Skill, or Power) and an optional TinkerTime RiderEffect. The card dynamically changes its behavior based on these properties. Target is AnyEnemy for Attack mode, Self for Skill/Power modes. Upgrade adds [gold]Innate[/gold] keyword. This card should not appear in standard card libraries.
